preprocessing_policy: Same clean_text and helper functions as source cell; vectorizer lowercase; no added stopword removal or stemming
xai_method: Exact linear contrastive feature contributions: x_j * (w_pred,j - w_comparator,j); intercept included in reconstruction
coaching_method: Rubric-based rules, separated from model feature attribution
demo_data_origin: 100 synthetic comments, one per fictitious student; generated for application demonstration
agreement_scope: Unweighted nominal Cohen kappa: initial human labels versus fixed model predictions, prior to adjudication
